title: PixelBench: Can LLMs Understand and Generate Images Pixel by Pixel?
abstract: arXiv:2611.02540v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can generate visual assets through text-based formats such as SVG and CAD, but these symbolic representations describe images using high-level primitives rather than explicit raster values. We ask whether LLMs can instead generate pixel images directly through their existing vocabulary, without a learned image tokenizer or decoder. We introduce PixelBench, a benchmark for text-to-pixel (T2P) and image-to-pixel (I2P) generation across multiple resolutions, together with a complementary pixel-understanding evaluation. Models generate an RGB color palette followed by a grid of indices specifying the palette color of each output pixel. In T2P, the strongest models produce recognizable images directly from text. In I2P, the strongest models outperform palette-matched downsampling and specialized pixelization algorithms at low resolutions. Pixel-understanding performance correlates strongly with generation perfor

translated_title: PixelBench：大语言模型能够逐像素地理解和生成图像吗？
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）可以通过SVG和CAD等基于文本的格式生成视觉素材，但这些符号化表示是使用高级图元来描述图像，而非显式的光栅数值。我们探讨LLM能否直接利用其现有词表生成像素图像，而无需经过学习的图像分词器或解码器。我们提出了PixelBench，这是一个涵盖多种分辨率的文本到像素（T2P）和图像到像素（I2P）生成基准，并附带一个互补的像素理解评估。模型首先生成一个RGB调色板，然后生成一个索引网格，用于指定每个输出像素对应的调色板颜色。在T2P任务中，最强的模型能够直接从文本生成可识别的图像。在I2P任务中，最强的模型在低分辨率下的表现超越了调色板匹配的下采样方法和专门的像素化算法。像素理解性能与生成性能之间存在很强的相关性。
tldr: 该论文提出PixelBench基准，证明大语言模型无需专门的图像分词器或解码器，仅凭现有词表即可直接生成可识别的像素图像，且像素理解能力与生成能力密切相关。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces PixelBench, a benchmark showing that LLMs can directly generate recognizable pixel images using only their existing vocabulary without any specialized image tokenizer or decoder, and that pixel-understanding performance strongly correlates with generation performance.
